name: item-context-feedback-1
body: source: feedback nested-sections/feedback-1 on requirements.requirement.item-context. Inconsistency: the requirement's only drives edge went to domain.value.item-context; because realised-by applies only from domain group|entity|service (not values), the spine dead-ended and item-context reached no solution component or code. Resolution: added drives requirements.requirement.item-context -> domain.service.render-deck (render-deck is realised-by solution.component.renderer, which is implemented-by internal/render code), keeping the existing drives to domain.value.item-context. The requirement now traces to code through the service [with user].
